summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026 disclosing that its board authorized a new share repurchase program for up to US$100 million of Class A ordinary shares, effective October 8, 2026 through October 7, 2028. The prior US$40 million program adopted in May 2025 was fully utilized. No price per share, premium or advisor was stated, and buybacks may occur via open-market or negotiated transactions subject to the F-3 shelf and S-8 registration statements incorporated by reference. Watch pacing and cash usage against mining capex and any overhang reduction.
